chunks: My father, my brother, 'Ali ibn al-Husayn, and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar, from Hamdan ibn Sulayman al-Naysaburi, from 'Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Yamani, from Mani' ibn al-Hajjaj, from Yunus ibn 'Abd al-Rahman, from Hanan ibn Sadir, from his father Sadir, who said:

Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'O Sadir, do you visit the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) every day?' I said, 'No.' He said, 'How negligent you people are!' He said, 'Do you visit him every Friday?' I said, 'No.' He said, 'Do you visit him every month?' I said, 'No.' He said, 'Do you visit him once a year?' I said, 'Sometimes.' He said: 'O Sadir, how negligent you people are toward al-Husayn (peace be upon him)! Do you not know that Allah has a thousand angels, disheveled and covered with dust, who weep for him and inherit him, who do not cease being visitors to the grave of al-Husayn, and their reward is for whoever visits him?' And he mentioned the hadith.

key_terms.شُعْثاً غُبْراً: Disheveled and covered with dust (describing angels)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of visiting the grave of Imam Husayn according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Ibn Qulawayh records Imam al-Sadiq’s (a.s.) pedagogical method of descending from daily to annual visits to highlight human spiritual negligence (*ajfā*). This narration underscores the Shia concept of *tawassul* through the angels, where their perpetual worship and mourning in the celestial realm are linked to the tangible reward earned by human visitors on earth, reinforcing the metaphysical significance of the Imam's grave.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 4. My father, my brother, ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain, and Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan all narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā Al-‘Aťťār, from Ḥamdān ibn Sulaymān Al-Naysābūri, from ‘Abdillāh ibn Muḥammad Al-Yamāni, from Manī’ ibn Ḥajjāj, from Yūnus ibn ‘Abdil Raḥmān, from Ḥanān ibn Sadīr, from his father Sadīr, who said:

Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) asked me, “O Sadīr! Do you perform the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) everyday?” I replied, “No.” Imam (a.s.) said, “How negligent you people are!!! Do you perform his Ziyārah every week?” I replied, “No.” Imam (a.s.) asked, “Do you perform his Ziyārah every month?” I replied, “No.” Imam (a.s.) asked, “Do you perform his Ziyārah once a year?” I replied, “Sometimes.” Imam (a.s.) said: O Sadīr! How negligent you people are toward Ḥusain (a.s.)!!! Do you not know that Allāh has one thousand angels who are disheveled and covered with dust, who lament and cry over Ḥusain (a.s.), and who perform the Ziyārah of his grave (at all times) without pause?! Verily the reward of their deeds is registered for those who go to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.).
